question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

Please ________ quiet, everyone; the principal will be here anytime.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb "**keep**" is the most appropriate choice to fit in the blank.
 
• The phrase "**keep quiet**" is a common expression used to ask people to remain silent.
 
• The other options (make, set, have) do not fit the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Please **keep** quiet, everyone; the principal will be here anytime."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Make:** This verb is generally used to form phrases like "make a noise" or "make a sound," which are not suitable in this context.
 
• **Set:** This verb is used in contexts like "set the table" or "set the alarm," which do not fit here.
 
• **Have:** This verb could be used in a variety of contexts but does not fit the phrase "have quiet."
